cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_zephyr C)

# Package descriptor generated by CMakeDeps (test_package/conanfile.py uses the
# CMakeDeps + CMakeToolchain generators).
find_package(zephyr REQUIRED)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Target 1 - link verification.
#
# Includes the packaged headers (zephyr/zephyr.h plus the <com_err.h> that
# zephyr.h includes and that the recipe propagates) and links zephyr::zephyr,
# so a successful build proves the package is consumable as a link target.
# test_package/conanfile.py asserts the resulting DT_NEEDED binding and runs the
# binary when the platform loader can resolve the packaged SONAME (see
# notes.md: on HarmonyOS it usually cannot for a stand-alone binary).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(test_zephyr_link test_link.c)
target_link_libraries(test_zephyr_link PRIVATE zephyr::zephyr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Target 2 - run-time verification through an absolute-path dlopen().
#
# This target intentionally links NOTHING from the package: it only borrows the
# interface include directories of zephyr::zephyr.  Linking the library would
# add DT_NEEDED libzephyr.so.4 and put the executable back under the loader's
# namespace restriction, which is exactly what must be avoided to be able to
# run the consumer test on this platform.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(test_zephyr_dlopen test_dlopen.c)
target_link_libraries(test_zephyr_dlopen PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_include_directories(test_zephyr_dlopen PRIVATE
    $<TARGET_PROPERTY:zephyr::zephyr,INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
